Job Title: Software Engineer (GIS Enterprise) 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 CACI has an outstanding opportunity for a select Software Engineer that wants to make a difference in the defense of the nation by applying their talents and experience in a fast-paced dynamic environment in support of US Special Operations Command. This opportunity is limited to self-starters with an advanced level of experience in planning, implementing, developing, and maintaining applications for a GIS Enterprise and capable of working independently in a fluid custom application development environment. You will be an integral part of a selective professional IT team that directly supports the operational planning cycle to support mission success. This position is in support of a Department of Defense (DoD) organization in Fayetteville, NC.

 Responsibilities: 
 Use advanced software engineering techniques to perform complex analysis, design and modification of applications and databases for GIS Enterprise.
 Perform software development, deployment, and maintenance of both custom and ad-hoc applications supporting geospatial intelligence analysis workflows. Utilize excellent communication skills to include technical writing and the ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
 Recommend innovative technologies that enhance the presentation and use of enterprise GIS products and provide integrated systems planning.
 Utilize exceptional problem solving and decision-making capabilities, including troubleshooting technical issues; successfully resolving project issues and challenges; and understanding user requirements to develop creative software solutions for process improvements.
 
 Qualifications: 

 Required:  
 Active TS/SCI clearance is required
 8 years software development experience
 Proficiency in C# and Python programming languages
 Ability to create and develop custom tools utilizing RDBMS, NoSQL data stores, and distributed process of large datasets.
 Able to perform high level/expert intelligence systems development design and evaluation.
 Possess strong oral and written communication skills
 Capable of performing as a team and effectively directing subordinates
 High level/expert ability to manage and work with static and dynamic streaming geospatial oriented data
 Required to obtain and maintain currency of the appropriate level certification in accordance with DODD 8570.01 (Security+)
 Ability and willingness to continue to expand your knowledge and experience base to be detail oriented and to prioritize and complete assigned tasks within required deadlines
 
 Desired: 
 Bachelor’s degree and three additional years of general experience in the intelligence community and geospatial systems experience are highly desirable.
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$93,500 - $196,500 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
